sentences.text: The remaining quantity falls in an undefined category, generally called an intermediate quantity.

sentences.text: The commercial quantity mandates a minimum sentence of ten years of imprisonment and a minimum fine of Rupees One hundred thousand, and bail is subject to the riders mandated in S. 37 of NDPS Act.

2. Brief facts of the case relevant for the purpose of disposal of this petition are that the aforementioned FIR had been registered on complaint lodged by the complainant-Bishambar Dass,
on the allegations that the accused Ashish, Kapil Sharma and Barkha Bhutani had formed four co-operative societies and represented them as Secretaries of those societies.
sentences._hearing_file: Rajesh Kumar vs State Of Haryana on 12 December, 2024.json

sentences.text: They had induced the complainant and several other public persons to deposit their money with the societies run by them by representing that the money so deposited would fetch annual compound interest at the rate of 1 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:107607 12% to 15% and the deposits would be completely safe, as they were to be lent to banks or government employees.
sentences._hearing_file: Rajesh Kumar vs State Of Haryana on 12 December, 2024.json

sentences.text: Huge amount of money deposited by the members of the society had been misused by the above named accused by purchasing Benami properties.
sentences._hearing_file: Rajesh Kumar vs State Of Haryana on 12 December, 2024.json

sentences.text: They had criminally misappropriated the money so deposited, thereby rendering the societies as bankrupt.
